entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi. I need to return something.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could I get your full name and order number?
The name is Sam Jones. I don't have the order number in front of me.
No problem at all, Sam. I can find your account with the email address you used for the purchase. What was it?
sam.jones.vip@email.com.

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see your recent order for the VeloBand Pulse. Now, to understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
I just don't like it. I want my money back.
I understand. Let me check the return eligibility for you. I see here the band was delivered on December 26th. That makes it about 25 days ago.
Okay. And?
Well, I'm afraid it's too late to start a return for this item. Our return policy for the VeloBand Pulse specifically is for 10 days from the date of delivery.
Ten days? That's it? That's a joke.

I understand it can seem short. The reason for that strict policy is based on hygiene. Because the VeloBand is worn directly on the skin and tracks personal biometrics, we cannot accept it back after that initial window for health and sanitation reasons.
So you're saying I'm just stuck with it. Fine. Whatever.

I truly am sorry for the disappointing news, and I can hear your frustration. While I cannot override the return policy due to those safety protocols, I do see you're a VIP member with us and we really value your business. As a courtesy, I'd like to offer you a complimentary 6-month subscription to VeloFit Premium for your trouble.
Great. A subscription for a product I don't want to use. Sure. Just add it.

Of course. I have just added the 6-month Premium credit to your account, effective immediately. I know this wasn't the outcome you were hoping for, but I hope you'll find some value in the advanced features. Was there anything else I could help with today?
No. That's all.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good rest of your day.
